title: Adding services to a service mesh

# Adding services to a service mesh {#ossm-create-mesh}

A project contains services; however, the services are only available if you add the project to the service mesh.

## Next steps {#_next_steps}

- To continue the installation process, you must [enable sidecar injection](/openshift-docs-markdown/service_mesh/v2x/prepare-to-deploy-applications-ossm#deploying-applications-ossm).
